claim: The episode frames large scale classification as selecting from a label set too large to place directly in one prompt.
Category descriptions are embedded so candidate retrieval can be changed independently of final model selection.
Similarity search returns a top K candidate set before the model makes the final classification.
The pipeline is split into smaller functions so each control can be changed and evaluated.
The implementation uses cosine similarity to rank embedded categories.
Retrieval and final category selection are traced as separate methods.
The speakers recommend evaluating on real user queries and using traces to locate where the pipeline went wrong.
